Task: Suggest three book recommendations on the history of mathematics.

Here are three well-regarded books on the history of mathematics:

1. “Mathematics and Its History” by John Stillwell  
   • Offers a broad survey connecting mathematical ideas to their historical development.  
   • Well-balanced between technical detail and historical narrative.

2. “Journey through Genius: The Great Theorems of Mathematics” by William Dunham  
   • Focuses on landmark theorems and the mathematicians behind them.  
   • Engagingly written, with clear explanations and historical context.

3. “The Crest of the Peacock: Non-European Roots of Mathematics” by George Gheverghese Joseph  
   • Highlights contributions from across Africa, Asia, and the Islamic world.  
   • Broadens the narrative beyond the traditional Eurocentric view.
